motion_energy_image — VIDEOSTREAM motion op

• 数据种类:video → video

• 调用:import videostream; videostream.motion_energy_image(video, tau: 'int' = 15, threshold: 'float' = 0.1) -> 'np.ndarray'(或 opsvideostream.get("motion_energy_image"))

用法

> 该算子的说明尚无译文,以下照原文给出。

Bobick–Davis Motion Energy Image per frame → 0/1 `(T, H, W) (video`).

The binary companion of :func:motion_history_image: *where* motion has

occurred within the last `tau frames (MHI > 0`), regardless of when.
